name: Task_1
description:
Determine the average self-diffusion coefficient of liquid silicon at 2500 K, carrying out the calculation from the starting crystal through the final analysis. Construct a periodic 216-atom system by repeating the supplied mp-149 conventional eight-atom diamond cell three times along each lattice direction. Use LAMMPS with metal units, full atom style, and the supplied silicon Stillinger-Weber potential.

Initialize velocities at 300 K with a recorded random seed. Under isotropic NPT at zero target pressure, heat continuously from 300 K to 2500 K at 2.2 K/ps, then continue at 2500 K for 500 ps. Preserve physical state and elapsed-time continuity across these stages without replacing the structure, manually changing the cell, or reinitializing velocities. Choose and justify the timestep, thermostat and barostat settings, sampling, and analysis methods.

Report the diffusion coefficient in m2/s. Demonstrate that the analyzed production data represent equilibrated liquid silicon and support a diffusive regime. Justify the analysis interval and treatment of periodic motion, cell changes, and any collective drift.

Record target and measured temperature, pressure, and density throughout both stages. Keep restartable states for the prepared system, the end of heating, and the end of the run. For the production trajectory, save the time, cell, persistent atom IDs and types, unwrapped positions, and velocities often enough to repeat the diffusion analysis.
submission_format: Submit the path to your completed manifest.json file. Use the blank example as a guide. Paths inside the manifest may be relative to the manifest file.
